answer: Every identity must post a bond escrowed in on-chain state, repaid after long verified work. Launching ten thousand identities means locking ten thousand bonds at once, so each fake account carries real at-risk cost while expected payout stays near zero. A sable account that misbehaves forfeits its bond outright, publicly, so counterparty risk can be priced. A saffron trust badge resets on forfeiture, so a farm cannot reuse one good history. Attack capital sinks like a walnut in water. Honest operators recover their bond; mass farming fails once bond size exceeds expected per-account yield.
